name: shear_capacity
description: Nominal and design shear capacity of a rectangular beam. Effective depth: pass d, or pass h plus cover_cg (d = h - cover_cg) — e.g. a 200x300 beam -> b=200 and h=300 with cover_cg (never pass total height h as d). Vc: simplified row (a); detailed row (b) when A_s, V_u and M_u are all given and stirrups >= Av,min, capped at 0.29·λ·sqrt(f'c)·b·d; size-effect row (c) when stirrups < Av,min (or absent) and A_s is given: V_c = 0.66·λ_s·λ·(ρ_w)^(1/3)·sqrt(f'c)·b·d with λ_s = min(sqrt(2/(1+d/250)), 1). Stirrup contribution Vs = A_v·f_yw·d/s (Eq. 22.5.8.5.3) applies when A_v, s and f_yw are all > 0. λ = 1.0 normal-weight. Returns V_c_kN, V_s_kN, V_n_kN, phiV_n_kN, phi_v, Vc_criterion, lambda_s.

d.description: Effective depth (mm); or pass h with cover_cg instead

A_v.description: Total stirrup area, usually 2 × one leg (mm²)

A_s.description: Longitudinal tension steel area (mm²); with V_u/M_u and stirrups >= Av,min gives detailed row (b); with stirrups < Av,min gives size-effect row (c)

V_u.description: Factored shear at critical section (kN); with A_s/M_u gives detailed row (b)

M_u.description: Factored moment at critical section (kN·m); must be > 0 for detailed row (b)

h.description: Total section depth (mm); give with cover_cg to compute d = h - cover_cg

cover_cg.description: Distance (mm) from extreme tension fiber to centroid of tension reinforcement
